rate_extension.agreement_policy: copy the common endpoint verdict without an additional Stage C call
rate_extension.disagreement_policy: one isolated pivotal-proposition check followed by endpoint-only selection
rate_extension.selection_policy: run all three models on method-design; run validation once only for models passing the method-design gate; do not tune prompts, decoding, or activation between splits

method_design_gate.attacked: Stage C correct count is strictly greater than both same-model RAG and same-model closed-book
method_design_gate.clean: Stage C accuracy is no more than 2 percentage points below the stronger clean endpoint

validation_reporting.attacked: report exact correct counts, paired gains/regressions, and exact two-sided McNemar p-values against both endpoints
validation_reporting.clean: report exact counts; because n=40 makes one error 2.5 points, separately flag zero-loss, one-claim-loss, and larger-loss outcomes

crossed_attacker_victim_diagnostic.claim_scope: the 61 development claims passing the second eligibility filter for all three victims
crossed_attacker_victim_diagnostic.matrix_policy: report all nine attacker-victim cells; do not select a weak attacker as a replacement primary setting
controls: reuse the already generated attacker-specific poison blueprints and expanded poison documents
hold each claim's clean corpus, nominal injection rate, retrieval implementation, top-k, victim prompt, and victim decoding fixed
use the victim model for all RAG planning, evidence answering, and verdict calls
regenerate no poison text for the initial crossed matrix
crossed_attacker_victim_diagnostic.purpose: separate poison-transfer strength from victim sensitivity; this diagnostic does not alter the primary same-model 1% result
